note: Placeholder programmer art for the lab / facility / prison levels, drawn by tools/blocks_themed.py; shapes follow scene mockups that are not in the repository.

observation-window.note: control-room glazing: slanted frame posts every 32 px, amber lit room, desks, monitors and staff

lab-window-cyan.note: framed window band onto a pale cyan lit lab: ceiling light bars, mullions every 32 px, hazard strip on the sill

specimen-tank-cyan.note: glass cylinder of cyan liquid with a dark specimen and bubbles, steel caps top and bottom

specimen-tank-green.note: two green-yellow specimen tanks per tile with curled specimens, base with hazard dashes

containment-tube-red.note: red-lit containment tube with a specimen, riveted rust collars, pipes into the top

bay-door-red.note: octagonal steel frame round a red-lit recessed bay behind bars, red lamp above

hazard-door-octagon.note: octagonal door frame with amber / dark hazard stripes, dark corridor of nested frames and red lights

blast-door-diagonal.note: heavy door leaf with red diagonal chevron panels, centre boss, riveted frame

cell-bars.note: prison cell front: vertical bars every 8 px, two crossbars, amber-lit cell behind, floor slab

cell-gate-arch.note: arched barred gate in a concrete block wall, dark red-lit inside, red lamp above

locker.note: two grey steel lockers per tile: one shut (vents, handle, label), one open with a suit inside

ceiling-light-cyan.note: fluorescent tube strip under a dark ceiling panel, cyan-white light spilling down the wall

terminal.note: standing console: two cyan screens, slanted desk of red / amber / cyan buttons, cabinet

lab-tile-wall.note: clinical wall of 16 px pale grey-cyan tiles with dark grout and light grime

stairs-yellow.note: steel stair flight at 45 degrees with a yellow handrail; the stair line enters at the bottom-left corner and leaves at the top-right corner, so tiles chain diagonally (place the next one up and right)

ladder-yellow.note: yellow ladder rails with rungs every 8 px over a dark wall, wall brackets

railing-yellow.note: thin yellow handrail and mid rail, posts every 32 px, toe board, walkway edge below

drain-culvert.note: arched culvert with vertical bars in a riveted wall, water pouring from its bottom
